const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+"""RoboPaint limited-mode episode controller and trajectory record notes."""
+import json, sys, math
+import numpy as np
+sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+robot = Robot()
+Q = np.array([0.0, 1.0, 0.0, 0.0], dtype=float)
+actions_log = []
+last = np.array(robot.get_obs(video="none").meta["proprio"]["now"][7:10], dtype=float)
+
+def move(points, note=""):
+    """Submit Cartesian waypoints; interpolate gently at ~6 mm per control row."""
+    global last
+    rows = []
+    p0 = last.copy()
+    for dest in points:
+        dest = np.asarray(dest, dtype=float)
+        n = max(1, int(math.ceil(np.linalg.norm(dest-p0)/0.006)))
+        for k in range(1, n+1):
+            p = p0 + (dest-p0)*(k/n)
+            rows.append(np.r_[p, Q])
+        p0 = dest
+    if not rows:
+        return None
+    a = np.asarray(rows, dtype=np.float32)
+    res = robot.submit("ee_pose", a, dt=0.05, video="both", cameras=("canvas_cam","practice_cam","scene_cam","side_cam"), video_fps=4, note=note)
+    res.save("/app/runs/latest")
+    actions_log.append({"note":note,"rows":len(a),"meta":res.meta})
+    last = a[-1,:3].astype(float)
+    print("SUBMIT",note,"rows",len(a),"plan",res.meta.get("plan"),"clipped",res.meta.get("clipped"),"steps",res.meta.get("control_steps_chunk"),flush=True)
+    return res
+
+def hold(pos, count, note="hold"):
+    return move([pos]*count, note)
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    # Rise, load the dry tuft in the ink stone, then make a controlled practice mark.
+    move([[0.0,0.0,0.15],[-0.10,0.15,0.07],[-0.10,0.15,0.023]],"ink dip approach")
+    hold([-0.10,0.15,0.023],8,"ink dip")
+    move([[-0.10,0.15,0.075],[-0.14,-0.17,0.075],[-0.14,-0.17,0.016],[-0.14,-0.205,0.016]],"practice probe 4mm press")
+    move([[-0.14,-0.205,0.075]],"lift from practice")
+    obs=robot.get_obs(cameras=("canvas_cam","practice_cam","scene_cam","side_cam"),video="none")
+    from PIL import Image
+    for cam,img in obs.last.items(): Image.fromarray(img).save(f"/app/runs/latest/after_{cam}.png")
+    print("OBS",json.dumps({"time_left_s":obs.meta.get("time_left_s"),"proprio":obs.meta.get("proprio")},default=str),flush=True)
*** End Patch";
const r = await tools.apply_patch(patch);
text(r);

+def world(u, v, z):

+    n = max(1, int(math.ceil(np.linalg.norm(end-start) / spacing_m)))
